title: Tee back
note: Kept: ropes that run straight off the JETS edges, chunky float bars with red end zones, a constant lane line with a T. Rejected: the blocky letterforms, the pennant bunting and the fighter-like jet.

title: Hoodie front
note: Kept: one hero tail code over a rule and a serial line, and a swept-fin A whose leading edge lines up with the red flash. Rejected: the run-on band text and the oversized sleeve type.

title: Crewneck
note: Kept: a moderate arch in a squared extra-condensed face, wrapping a solid red jet over a horizon line. Rejected: stencil cuts on every letter and the faked letter widths.

title: Hip lockups
note: Kept: JETS locked to the jet's wingspan with a tight gap. Rejected: the detached tail fins and nozzles (too close to real fighters, and they fill in at this size).

title: Stencil lettering
note: Kept: only vertical and horizontal bridges, an E split from its stem, a T gap under the bar, and a pointed A split by a slit. Rejected: uneven widths and tiny 3% bridges.

title: Jet mark
note: Kept: a stouter nose, bigger wingtips and a cut down the spine. Rejected: panel lines, canted fins and the chevron, which read as real aircraft or decals.
